verses.2: Let it be said to you: It will happen, and it will be stopped in its tracks. Who can stop it?
verses.3: Now, you have removed many people; but those hands that are weak will still continue to struggle.
verses.4: They will create them from clay, and with their blessings, they will make them strong.
verses.5: For now, he will come to you; he will touch you and cause you to be confused.
verses.6: Do not let your eyes be like those of a serpent; do not follow its ways.
verses.7: Please remember who it was that went away, and where they have gone.
verses.8: When I saw the thorns and the seeds of labor being gathered together.
verses.9: From the spirit of God, they will be destroyed; from the breath of Apo, they will be consumed.
verses.10: The lion cried out, and there was a loud noise. Two arrows were also shot.
verses.11: Layish was destroyed by his own greed, and the sons of Labia were separated from each other.
verses.12: And there was a stolen word; then Shemuel took my ears away from him.
verses.13: In the twilight of the night, a nightmare falls upon people.
verses.14: Fear seized me, and my body trembled. Most of my body was in fear.
verses.15: And the spirit on my face will be troubled, and my lips will be choked.
verses.16: He will stand there, but I won’t be able to see his face. His voice and scent will be heard clearly before my eyes.
verses.17: Is a man righteous if his actions lead to his purification from sin?
verses.18: Nor in his servants will he trust, nor in his works will he place any trust.
verses.19: Even though those who live in houses made of wood will be destroyed by fire before they can do anything.
verses.20: From morning to evening, they will be destroyed; they will not be able to survive forever.
verses.21: They will not go to them; they will die, and not in wisdom.
